title: Compare-exchange, uniform load, texture barrier
blurb: The three synchronisation builtins WGSL has and this surface lacked (§48): `atomicCompareExchangeWeak`, whose result struct WGSL gives no writable name so it is bound by inference and read field by field; `workgroupUniformLoad`, a read of workgroup memory between two barriers that every invocation must reach; and `textureBarrier`. `compile()` emits WGSL and no GLSL text for it: that is not supported yet by the GLSL backend (Rule 10.5). So this one is `renderable: false` and the gate runs its Tint half alone.
